title: The Smarter Home
description: Smart home system with RF24 radio communication between devices.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A smart home system designed to overcome the issues of modern smart systems. It uses one hub device that is connected to the internet, while all other node devices are connected to the hub using 2.4 GHz RF24 Radio. The hub device is controlled via an iOS App through a global server.

sections.title: Technology Stack
content: Firebase - For the hub device and iOS app to communicate

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: To provide a secure, fast, and stable Smart Home System.

sections.title: Achievement
sections.content: This project placed in the Top 6 at McHacks VII as a solo developer.
